fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Trim vegetation along the front driveway to maintain clear sightlines and overhead clearance for responding vehicles.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move directly between the two buildings.
• Mark or identify all access points to the property so responders arriving from any direction can quickly locate entry.
• Keep the walkway clear of obstructions so responders can move around the structure on foot without detours.
• Thin dense vegetation near the main residence and detached structure so responders can approach and work around both buildings without obstruction.
• Keep the open lawn area free of parked vehicles and stored equipment so it can be used as a staging area for emergency personnel and equipment.
• Trim dense vegetation away from any gates or secondary access points so responders can locate and open them quickly.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing directly against or touching the house.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure to increase open space between tree canopies and the building.
• Remove any dead branches or dry plant material visible near the base of the structure.
• Keep low-hanging branches on trees near the house trimmed up from the ground.
• Clear shrubs and small plants from the immediate area around the foundation.
• Maintain open ground between shrub clusters and the structure to reduce continuous plant coverage leading to the building.
